argv: A report-section contract covering warnings, assumptions, missing solve and rule inputs, user-supplied values, provenance, units, reproducibility references, and professional-review notices is produced.

The contract preserves upstream diagnostic class, severity, source, affected object, message, remediation and provenance when supplied; exposes missingness rather than defaulting it; protects private/protected content; and makes no certification, approval, sealing, authentication, or automatic-compliance claim.

Validate the contract and review source parity, all warning and missing-data classes, trace-field preservation, unit and provenance visibility, manifest references, protected-content controls and fallback review, prohibited-claim language, and every retained TBD or governed residual.
